notes.title: Anniverasry update + Linux release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! For the anniversary of our game's launch, we've prepared an update for you! 

Great news for Linux gamers: Bosorka is now available for you too! We received requests to port it, and as promised, we’ve delivered. Let us know on our forums or via email about your experience!

We've worked on the base game as well to make it even more enjoyable. Among other things, we've added the ability to revive another player in local multiplayer, improved some enemy attacks, and reworked the tornado in the Steppe location (yes, it will hurt less now)

Main changes:
  • Boss rebalance
  • Improved attacks of the Cynocephalus, Lisovyk, and Ancybolot (better attacks timings, you can now read and dodge their attacks)
  • Reworked enemy spawn intensity
  • Tornadoes in the Steppe location no longer teleport players (so as not to disturb the rabbits unnecessarily), and now just deals damage over time, so try to avoid them anyways
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/ab63ea3854dd363ddc9f1ea81a341b2b3476f803.gif[/img]
  • Optimized the Arc and Sunsprout spells
  • Adjusted attack timing for the Wind Gust and Lonica spells
  • Added the ability to revive a player in local multiplayer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/aa30bb3ce58a7c10a3a352c7e0121b19f346f8de.gif[/img]
  • Fixed curse indication in the statistics window
  • Fixed the return-to-main-menu button on gamepads
  • Fixed an empty field selection in the options
  • Improved performance

Thank you for being with us, have a great flight!

notes.title: Nintendo Switch Port + PC Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/020a5fbd4b88f6db40409cb71758e20050ff0b26.png[/img]
Hey everyone! As you may have guessed from the header image and summary, we’re hard at work porting Bosorka to Nintendo Switch. It took us some time to deliver a smooth, polished experience like on PC, and things are going exceptionally well.

We’ll share the estimated release date later, but it looks like the wait won’t be too long. For more updates and progress, join our [url=https://discord.gg/6ztf483]Discord [/url]community! Additionally, we’re planning to host giveaways featuring fun activities. So even if you’re already a proud owner of the game (for which we’re truly grateful), you still have the opportunity to win a Nintendo Switch copy for yourself or a friend!

In addition, we’ve updated the PC version with these improvements:

[list]
[*]Boss Rebalance: Some bosses were overly aggressive and difficult to defeat, limiting players from crafting effective builds. We’ve adjusted their difficulty for a more balanced challenge.
[*]UI Improvements: We fixed issues with enemy health bars and refined some rough layout elements.
[*]Optimizations: Although the game runs smoothly for most players, we identified a few areas that could lead to stuttering during long sessions. These have now been addressed.
[*]Crash Fixes: A rare issue triggered by changing the localization in the main menu could cause crashes later on. We’ve resolved this to ensure a stable gameplay experience.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch notes V.1.0.32
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! We are excited to present to you a new major update! We have added a local co-op mode with split-screen, so now you can enjoy playing together with your friends on the couch! The game supports up to 4 players simultaneously. Additionally, with the help of Steam Remote, you can even play online! We are continuously working on further enhancing this mode and would greatly appreciate any feedback and suggestions from you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/8f240b2af266c0b083b8d705e64c114da7b774db.png[/img]

In this update, we have made changes to the Motanka rune, now the more of these runes you accumulate, the more defensive bubbles you'll get.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/19860efc46505af768d27c0dccef8c1b00f4d64a.gif[/img]

We have also added a new rune that allows you to heal companions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/9c45a9dd037ba6bf3692c93e1a09bb5b4b4f87bf.gif[/img]

And we added lore for creatures in the bestiary and for some locations! We hope you like it.

Furthermore, we have fixed numerous major and minor bugs that you reported, while possibly adding a few new ones ;)
Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy the new features and improvements. Happy gaming!
[/h3]

notes.title: Patch notes V.1.0.31
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are excited to present to you a new major update that includes not only fixes but also new content! Here's what awaits you:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/efb40ea3252817a4883966d9783b8bb889a352d5.png[/img]

[h3]Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bestiary! Now you can not only view the characteristics of creatures and runes but also learn about their origins and additional information. For each lore entry, we have added new trials that allow you to unlock them. We are still working on creature descriptions and will make them available in upcoming updates
[*] Curses! By completing special trials at different levels, you will have the ability to apply curses to yourself, which change the game rules in new playthroughs. These changes are aimed at experienced players, making your run more challenging and offering new rewards
[*] New achievements! Based on your feedback, we have added even more trials for which you will receive new runes, as before
[*] Added dungeons that contain trials to unlock new curses. You can find their entrances in the Wells located at the end of certain locations
[*] New runes have been added to the game, such as: Firesteel, Leech, Red Rose, Silver Mirror, and Bufo. We look forward to seeing the new combinations you can create with them
[*] New item - Trinity Stone, which allows you to purchase one of the three well-known runes 
[*] Adjusted balance for damage, health, and useful items at each level. We are experimenting and refreshing the pace of your runs, hoping that you will enjoy these changes
[*] The overall run now consists of four chapters. This slightly increases the time for each run, giving you the opportunity to create even stronger rune builds and unlock their potential
[*] Improved AI for elite monsters and bosses. They will now have more interesting and powerful attacks Additionally, some bugs that you may have encountered in previous versions of the game have been fixed
[*] "All-inclusive"! Your brooms now have amulets and curses attached to them
[*] You can now refresh the assortment at the Waterman. Find what interests you, but will it be a free action considering his greed? - A rhetorical question
[*] Added Statue of Chornoboh. (The person who wrote the description for this update was afraid to activate it. Maybe you will be braver and give it a try?)
[*] Enhanced visual effects in various locations, including the abilities of the Viper broom
[*] You can now revive fallen companions with their souls. A very welcome exchange
[*] Changes also affected active runes. As a result, the Black Candle rune creates fiery sparks from defeated fire enemies, and the Phantom Heart rune has now become legendary. Let's welcome its upgrade!
[*] Improved interface scaling in the game, displaying inflicted damage and effects. Added new information: the ability to see fallen companions
[*] As usual, we have further optimized the game, fixed a number of rare and minor bugs that you have reported to us before
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes V.0.1.30
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we have a fresh and juicy update for you. New location and boss with an enemy, trading cards, saving the game, quality of life improvements, and rebalance. Let's dive into the details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/820ef9ce48cb787ce629abc813705900e90a6a15.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brand new location with new unique boss and creature...also there are tornadoes! Prepare your spells and don't forget about the safety belt, it's gonna be a wild trip!
[*] Trading Cards! Badges! Backgrounds! Emoticons! All this is now available via Steam, we've put lots of effort and love into them and hope you will enjoy collecting them all! 
[*] You gave us feedback about saving progress, and we heard it. From now on you can exit the game and after, continue your run. Just be aware that after loading you will begin from the start of the Сhapter.
[*] Scaling UI options! If you would like to make an in-game UI smaller or bigger - this option is for you. It will be helpful both for someone who would like more space and for someone who plays the game on a smaller screen which makes text harder to read. 
[*] We reforged the balance of the game, and now you will have many more lootable objects per Chapter, keep in mind that opening them all will require extra effort.
[*] As we are implementing new localizations we updated all the fonts of the game as well to support extra characters and symbols. They are now stronger, and faster they are better! 
[*] We've read that some of you didn't quite like the basic parameters of Vitreous broom, so we refined them. Also, this broom has a reworked ultimate ability!
[*] You can now destroy acid bubbles of Bolotyanyk on the Swamp location, it's not like he will be happy about it though.
[*] Hola amigos! We now fully support Spanish localization. If we will gather enough requests for your preferred language we might add it next updates as well, so just make your localization branch on forums and see how many players are also awaiting it! 
[*] Did you know that working without focus is not effective? Well, now that we know it, it's time to practice it properly - let's not work at all if we lose focus. We applied this philosophy to our game as well, and now you have the option to freeze the game when you switched the game window to something else.
[*] For those of you who like a clear view we added an option to hide damage numbers, so you can see more clearly how enemies receive spells in their demon faces.
[*] Healing totem gained more power, it will now give 5hp to your companions and 1hp directly to you.
[*] We tweaked the balance of a few spells like Bubbles and Ecballium. This rebalance reduces charges in one and increases damage speed for the other.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sometimes ability music didn't play properly after unpausing and reviewing, well now it's not the case anymore.
[*] We will find out who did that to you! Our in-game detective system can now track more precisely who or what did a fatal blow to a young witch and display it properly on post-death screen statistics. Now go and get your revenge on that exploding pumpkin!
[*] We had some issues in the previous version with attracting items with a Copper Pin rune that now are solved. 
[/list]

notes.title: Roadmap & Patch notes V.1.0.28
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we’re hoping you will get a great weekend, and add our little bit to make it even better here are some news on Bosorka!

While we appreciate you having a great time with the game, we got requests to add more things to the game and evolve it even further. So here we are presenting you what our future updates could look like, you can consider it as a roadmap for new free content we will be adding (keep in mind, things listed in here are not in order) :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/2fe12c2ff1edd64defd1a8724b3293404dc49606.png[/img]

[h3]New Runes and Spells[/h3]
Yes, we will add them as we go and you can expect much more new toys to play with. Runes require an elegant approach, as they can combine with the existing ones and things can get messy. We are not afraid when builds get really powerful, though would like to test if they will not ruin the experience in a bad way. The more runes we are having - the more tests are required (as things begin to multiply with each other), so if we will miss something - let us know and we will take a look what we could’ve missed.
[h3]Local Coop[/h3]
Well, here’s that. We have an unusual idea about this mode, and it could be something really fresh and interesting, but first of all we need to try it out by ourselves. The game is built around playing with one character, so it will require some adjustments and testing. Most probably before launching it live, we will make a few closed beta tests, so make sure to signin on our Discord if you want to help us test things out (link is in the description of the Steam page).
[h3]Lore and Story[/h3]
There are a few really cool ideas how we could fullfill curiosity for those of you who like not only action, but also knowledge on what stands behind the curtains. You can expect more interactions with existing NPC’s, and also descriptions about how things are settled in Bosorka.
[h3]Online Coop*[/h3]
This is by far the most challengin thing to implement, it requires lots, even tons of effort. But we will do our best to research in this direction as we continue to expand the base game. As it also needs more resources, we will be more confident in realisation of this idea based on how the game performs in terms of sales. It is indeed a hard task, though we eager to try it at some point.
[h3]Localization[/h3]
We would like to make Bosorka as comfortable as possible to variety of players all around the World, pretty soon we will annonce a new available language options. Also, if you would like to help us out to bring this game to your native language and have a solid knowledge of some specific language - reach us out over Discord and we can talk about possible collaboration.
[h3]Music[/h3]
We had a really warm feedback about the music in Bosorka so in upcoming updates there will be new fresh material of our composer LightReturn, it will help with diversity and will add a new layer of fresh emotions.
[h3]New locations and more[/h3]
We are also eager to bring you more challenges and locations, alongside with additional activities. You can expect to see more things to do and more places to go, more details in upcoming developers notes.


As you can see we have a plenty of work ahead, and plenty of new fun things to add for you. If we missed something you personally would like to see - reach us out, we are friendly and love to communicate!  

[h1]Patch notes v.1.0.28[/h1]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] More tips. Added a few more tips like how not to drown in water or use amulets
[*] When picking up blueprints of new scrolls no longer reveal the name of it
[*] When picking up a phantom heart while being damaged it also adds as a bonus instead of applying to heal
[*] You can now pick up a phantom heart while holding a cursed rune “Ruby Ring” which limits the maximum health of the player
[*] Added immune notification on top of the enemies that can not be affected by certain statuses
Localization and UI improvements
[*] Runes and spell descriptions are not showing in its full length, and you no longer need to open the equipment window to read it through
[*] The new Patch Notes button on the main menu will keep you updated on what changed in the last version of the game
[*] All bosses now attack the closest target without choosing a player in a priority
[*] Changed behavior of bosses on Ghost broom ability. When activating this ability they will switch targets on your companions, or use AOE attacks in case you don’t have one
[*] Improvements in Chornobog AI. Now he will activate his dodge ability after his attacks
[*] Chornobog max health is now 2400
[*] Changed chests balance in Chapter 2 and Chapter 3
[*] Stamina depletion is improved when sprinting. Now stamina depletes based on the distance player traveled instead of the time the sprint button was pressed
[*] The cursed companion now heals himself by 2 points in exchange of the half heart of the player
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug of not being able to continue the game when the player had a “Kitty” rune and died at the same time as a boss
[*] Fixed a bug of not being able to pick up a book after Chornobog was defeated
[*] Fixed a bug where your companion could stuck in the well after moving to a new chapter
[*] Fixed a bug with a cursed companion, which could break the game on the final boss location when you won the fight with him
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes V.0.1.27
notes.content:
Hello everybody! We would like to thank each and every one of you for supporting us and giving valuable feedback! Meanwhile, we’ve made several improvements and fixed some bugs.

Improvements[list]
[*]Added elite monsters on the first location, just so you could challenge yourself and gather that fancy blueprints of new spells
[*]Healing apples no longer pick up when you have maximum hearts already
[*]“Last breath dash” - you can perform one last dash even if you depleted your stamina too much and lack just a bit
[*]You can now bind additional buttons on your mouse to perform desired actions
[*]Amulets now have their own cooldowns and don't reset after changing to a new one
[*]Rune descriptions were not cropping correctly
[*]Disabled rudimental ability to change spells on the defeat screen
[/list]

Bug fixes[list]
[*]Fixed burning effect visuals, previously it was not visualizing properly
[*]Fixed gamepad support. Some players reported their system had difficulties recognizing their gamepad in the game. We’ve made a few changes that should cover this issue
[*]Fixed a rare crash that was experienced by a few players at the start of the game
[*]Fixed a few localization issues
[*]Fixed a rare bug with a Copper Pin rune

[/list]

Also, we will much appreciate further feedback!
Write your wishes or suggestions and we will treat them with respect!

Cheers,
Sengi Games

notes.title: Bosorka Release
notes.content:
Bosorka is an exciting combination of roguelike and shoot 'em up genres, with top-down 3D visualization that immerses you in a dark fantasy world. Explore various locations, each with its own unique atmosphere, mysteries, and dangerous creatures. Secret rooms, hidden passages, and breathtaking landscapes offer real incentives to explore the environment.

At the end of each level, powerful bosses from the netherworld guard the passages to the next locations, making it a challenging experience. You can raise an entire army of companion demons to help you fight against the enemy. They have marvelous abilities that can come in handy.

With powerful spells at your disposal, you can destroy enemy hordes of evil creatures. But be cautious; some of these spells can be dangerous. Collect runes to make your own unique collection, each with its own specialty.

In addition to all these features, you can enjoy an exciting flight on a broomstick, which is not only a means of transportation but also capable of much more. Unlock all the brooms, master their special skills, and find your favorite to lead you to victory.

We hope you have a great time showing the demons who's boss!

notes.title: Patch notes V.0.1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/735566053e267c30575af8606bfbefbb92796d3f.png[/img]
[h1]Version updated[/h1]
Hello, a hotfix just came out to fix several annoying bugs.

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved wind ability storm, now deals regular damage
[*] Improved UI stamina bar, now with black shadow line!
[*] Added hints option in Options
[*] Improved stacking of perks
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed heal totem, now it works
[*] Fixed some text blocks in Equipment window
[*] Fixed Aim bugs
[/list]

Cheers,
Sengi Games

notes.title: Bosorka on Steam Fest!
notes.content:
We're so excited to be participants in the ongoing Steam Next Fest! We've been working super hard on this Demo and now can't wait for you to try it out! Let us know what you think of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43068420/206932cc1bb840f935b455ebfd805ef594f306ea.gif[/img]

   [b]Here are some features of this Demo:[/b]

[list]
[*] Dozens of different spells and runes

[*] Two atmospheric locations

[*] Powerful Bosses that guard the exits of these locations

[*] Variety of enemies that will test your might and broom-flying skills

[*] Three brooms with unique abilities

[*] Chance to find something interesting from a merchant
[/list]

   We're super excited and hope that you'll love the game as much as we do!
Stay tuned to the latest news regarding this game on our Discord! Feedback is much welcomed!
